name: zmodel_const_compute_polygon_plane_equation
description: zModel_Const::ComputePolygonPlaneEquation computes a Newell plane equation and returns the output plane pointer.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the zModel polygon/source-cluster pass because x87 stack scheduling is significant.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x482e30 validates the fastcall ABI with vertexCount in ecx, vertices in edx, outPlane on the stack, and outPlane returned in eax.

Binary Ninja assembly validates Newell normal accumulation, vertex-sum accumulation, normal-length/inverse scaling, plane normal stores, and d = -(vertexSum dot unnormalizedNormal) / (vertexCount * normalLength).
The native smoke verifies the returned outPlane pointer and the expected +Z plane equation for a unit square in the XY plane.
